summary: E2E frontend testing of the new branded Developer Portal at /developers plus regression on Demo and Admin portals. All 8 scenarios from the review_request passed (67/67 individual checks). Backend resource endpoints re-confirmed 200 via in-page fetch.
critical_code_review_comments: data.js: API base derived from process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is correct; resource hrefs resolve to /api/* on the same origin and all return 200.
DevChrome/Hero use a local scrollTo helper duplicated across files (minor DRY) - could be lifted into a shared util but acceptable for a small portal.
PlatformStatus.jsx fetches /api/health once on mount with no AbortController, but it does set an 'active' flag and uses early-return — fine; consider a small retry/backoff if needed.
Resources.jsx renders <a target='_blank'> with rel='noreferrer' (good security default).
CodeBlock copy uses navigator.clipboard.writeText and falls back to a 'Copied' UI state — works under Playwright when clipboard permission granted; UI state was verified for all 5 steps.
Sdks.jsx postman-download link points to /api/resources/docs/postman_collection.json and returns 200 — correct.
DevelopersPage uses document.title side-effect in useEffect — fine; no cleanup needed.
Admin sidebar 'Developer Portal' link (Layout.jsx) uses target='_blank' which is consistent with opening external/dev portal in new tab; no a11y issues observed.

success_rate.backend: n/a (frontend-only per request); 16/16 resource endpoints returned 200 via fetch

seed_data_creation: None. Process Transaction click on / produced one additional FEA on the default tenant (expected demo behavior, no TEST_ prefixed data introduced).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Developer Portal at /developers is fully functional. Verified: (1) page + all 7 sections render with correct data-testids; (2) header nav links and hero CTA smooth-scroll to target sections; (3) all 5 onboarding steps render and every Copy button transitions to 'Copied' state on click; (4) 9 resource cards present with correct hrefs and all backend resource endpoints (Swagger /api/docs, ReDoc /api/redoc, /api/openapi.json, /api/developer, /api/resources/docs/*.md, /api/resources/docs/postman_collection.json, /api/resources/sdks/*) return HTTP 200; (5) 4 SDK cards (python/javascript/java/dotnet) render with install snippets, View source links resolve to valid 200 URLs, postman-download present; (6) Platform Status shows all 6 status cards and platform-live-pill reads 'All systems operational' after fetching /api/health; (7) Cross-portal nav: demo-nav-developers on / navigates to /developers, admin-nav-developers appears in admin sidebar footer after login (href=/developers, opens new tab); (8) Regression — Demo / still loads and process-transaction-btn flow still produces proof content; /admin/login still loads and login succeeds with seeded admin creds. Platform pill text 'All systems operational' confirmed via /api/health=200.
rca of the issue: No issues observed; Developer Portal implementation matches the spec end-to-end.
